# Master Subscription Agreement v4 (excerpt)

11. Term and termination. Each Order Form runs for the term it states. Either party may
terminate an Order Form for the other's uncured material breach on 30 days' notice. There
is no termination for convenience unless an Order Form's special terms grant one.

12. Fees. Fees are non-cancellable and non-refundable except as an Order Form's special
terms or a written agreement signed by both parties provide. Tallow may suspend service
for invoices more than 45 days overdue.

13. Updates. Tallow provides updates and security patches to the hosted Platform. Nothing
in this Agreement obliges Tallow to deliver releases to a copy the Customer runs itself.
